integrity: Proof supplied; exhaustive finite checks are supporting reproducibility evidence, not certification of the all-size theorem.
scientific_limitations: Strict sign classification is for simple uniform labeled G(n,m) with n>=4; it does not assert total negative association or higher-degree-count signs. Independent-edge covariance is previously known, not new. Full historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: A sharp fixed-edge anticorrelation law for isolated and degree-one vertices
